This directory contains unmodified files from Three.js **0.180.0**:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`

They were copied from the locally installed Three.js dependency of
`motion-and-detection/viz_tools/3dviz/web_frontend`. The upstream release is
<https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180>. Three.js is distributed under
the MIT license; see `THREE-LICENSE`.

The viewer loads these local files directly. It requires no CDN, npm install,
or frontend build step.
